description: This Java class 'Layer' manages a 3D transformation layer with rotation capabilities around X, Y, or Z axes, supporting animation start/end, angle setting, and shape transformations.

classes.name: Layer
classes.description: A class representing a transformable layered object with animation control and axis-based rotation.

methods.name: Layer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the layer with a specified axis and setting identity transformation.

methods.name: startAnimation
methods.description: Starts animation for all contained shapes.

methods.name: endAnimation
methods.description: Ends animation for all contained shapes.

methods.name: setAngle
methods.description: Sets rotation angle around the specified axis, normalizing the angle and updating shape transformations accordingly.
